description: This is a Java class implementing a command handler for updating tax groups within the Apache Fineract platform. It uses Spring annotations and delegates the update logic to a service class.

classes.name: UpdateTaxGroupCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to update tax groups, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to update a tax group by delegating to the TaxWritePlatformService.
